# QC and comparability report (Phase 2)

**Date:** 2026-11-22. **Generated by:** `scripts/05_qc.py` (metrics), `scripts/04_fetch_run_metadata.py` (ENA read counts) and `scripts/06_gene_universe.py`. **Files:** `qc/qc_sample_metrics.csv` (one row per sample), `qc/qc_technical_vs_treatment.csv`, `qc/overlap_checks.csv`, and one two-panel figure per dataset, `qc/<GSE>_qc.png`. Each figure shows a PCA of the contrast samples and technical depth by group.

These are descriptive checks. An association between a technical property and treatment is reported as a **risk**. It is not evidence of an artefact and not evidence of a biological effect.

## 2. Treatment-aligned technical differences (planned contrasts)

Recall: in GSE294180 every PE library was shallower than every vehicle library (complete separation). The same check here:

| Contrast | Depth ratio case/control (median) | MW p | Complete separation of depth? | Other aligned properties |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MASH_primary (GSE316023 TA) | 0.93 (counted reads 0.91) | 0.13 | No | Detected genes higher in GAN (14,343 vs 13,663; **separated**). Plausibly biological: steatotic, inflamed liver expresses more immune and fibrotic genes. |
| MASH_sens_TN | 1.01 | 0.88 | No | Detected genes separated (as above); muscle score 1.7× higher in GAN (p = 0.02; tiny absolute values, below 1 CPM) |
| MASH_secondary (GSE246328) | 1.02 | 1.0 | No | Detected genes separated (13,581 vs 12,261); yield 0.80 vs 0.77 (p = 0.03) |
| **FASTING_primary (GSE107787)** | **1.16** (fasted deeper) | **0.001** | No | **Muscle-gene signal: FED median 51.8 vs FAST 0.75 summed RPKM (p < 0.001).** FED ZT8–ZT20 livers are also the shallowest libraries. |
| FASTING_secondary (GSE225695) | 0.80 (fasted shallower) | 0.10 | **Yes (n = 3 v 3)** | Counted/sequenced reads 0.82 vs 0.62 (separated) |
| **PPARA_primary (GSE282998 WT)** | **1.68** | 0.13 | No | **Muscle signal: 2 of 4 vehicle mice about 200–270 CPM vs ≤ 15 in 5/20 mg/kg mice.** Depth is clustered by dose group (0 and 5 mg/kg about 12–15 M; 10 and 20 mg/kg about 21–29 M). |
| PPARA_specificity_KO | 0.56 | 0.02 | No | Same muscle pattern |

### Findings that Phase 3 must handle

1. **GSE107787 muscle carry-over is aligned with feeding state.**
   - Summed skeletal-muscle RPKM is about 40–140 in FED livers at ZT8, 12, 16 and 20, about 1 in FED at ZT0 and ZT4, and below 1 in fasted livers (one FAST_ZT04 liver: 300).
   - The 72 liver and muscle libraries were multiplexed together in 3 pools of 24 (paper Methods). Index cross-talk from muscle libraries is a likely mechanism, but it is **not proven**.
   - **Handling:**
     - exclude muscle-enriched genes from the fasting axis (the gene list must be fixed before results are seen);
     - add a muscle-score covariate as a sensitivity analysis;
     - report the fasting axis with and without the ZT8–ZT20 FED samples.
   - This mirrors the muscle problem in GSE294180 and is a reason not to use muscle genes in any similarity score.
2. **GSE282998 muscle signal and depth follow dose group, in all three strains.**
   - In every strain, 2 of 4 mice in the 0 and 10 mg/kg groups carry muscle signal; none of the 5 or 20 mg/kg mice do.
   - Read depth is also grouped by dose.
   - This looks like a processing or sequencing batch shared between dose groups, but no batch variable is deposited.
   - **Handling:**
     - exclude muscle genes;
     - pre-register 10 vs 0 mg/kg as the batch-matched sensitivity contrast;
     - use the KO arm to check whether any "response" appears without PPARα.
3. **GSE225695:** depth and the counted/sequenced ratio separate fed from fasted, at n = 3. This adds to the reasons (unknown sacrifice time, n = 3) to use it only as a direction check.
4. **MASH references:** no depth confounding. Detected-gene counts are higher in GAN livers in both studies; this is expected with disease-associated cell infiltration. The MASH contrasts should still be fitted with standard size-factor normalisation, and Phase 3 should confirm that results do not depend on low-count genes.

## 3. Sample outlier screen

Rule: a sample's mean Pearson correlation (log scale, expressed genes) to the other members of its group falls below the dataset median − 3 × 1.4826 × MAD. This is a screening rule only. **No sample was removed.**

Flagged samples are listed in `qc/qc_sample_metrics.csv` (`corr_outlier_flag`):

| Flag | Interpretation |
|---|---|
| GSE316023 SD_wk23_B_R2 (TN sensitivity case); 3 wk12/wk16 samples not in any contrast | Single samples with slightly lower within-group r (0.94–0.95). Keep; check influence in Phase 3. |
| GSE246328 16211 (Vehicle 24 w) and 16234 (chow 24 w) | r ≈ 0.95. Keep; leave-one-out in Phase 3. |
| GSE107787 all 3 FAST_ZT12 livers; GSE117134 2 of 3 WT_ZT20; GSE225695 all 3 Fed | Whole groups flagged. These are more heterogeneous groups, not single outliers. Not actionable as exclusions. |
| GSE282998 1528_126 (J:ARC(S) 5 mg/kg; sensitivity arm only) | Lowest r in the arm (0.88); fewest detected genes. Review before using the outbred sensitivity arm. |
